title: Using LLMs to discover emerging coded antisemitic hate-speech in extremist social media
findings: The paper's proposed methodology, combining TF-IDF with post-truncation embeddings from a fine-tuned BERT model, effectively discovers new, coded antisemitic terminology from social media posts. The most advanced version of their pipeline achieved 80% accuracy and a 72% F-score in identifying these terms, demonstrating the viability of using semantic similarity to track evolving hate speech.
